item.title: Cache Tech Community Meetup - August 2026
item.description: Join us on Saturday, August 22nd, 2026 for Stop Vibing Your Prompts — What Two Years of AI Lab Notes Taught Me. See how engineering-grade notes, failure logs, and changelogs can turn trial-and-error prompting into an evidence-driven process. All skill levels are welcome!
